blocks.en: We now return to the differentiation operator $(\mathcal{D}(D),D)$ defined in Example~\ref{ex:differentiation-operator-domain-and-unboundedness}. In our comments above, we alluded to the fact that the domain of the operator was not ``optimal,'' in that it did not include such obvious functions as piecewise differentiable functions. We can now see that the problem is that the operator is not closed. We construct the closure as we did in the proof of Lemma~\ref{lem:closable-operator-zero-sequence-criterion} above. That is, we define the domain $\mathcal{D}(\overline D)$ of the closure to be the functions $u\in L^2(0,L)$ such that there exists a sequence $u_n\in\mathcal{D}(D)$ and an element $v\in L^2(0,L)$ such that\begin{enumerate}\item $u_n\to u$ in $L^2(0,L)$ and\item $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}u_n}{\mathrm{d}x}\to v$ in $L^2(0,L)$.\end{enumerate}However, this is simply the definition of the Sobolev space\[\mathcal{D}(\overline D):=\{u\in H^1(0,L)\mid u(0)=0\},\]where the boundary condition is taken in the sense of trace.
blocks.zh: 现在回到 Example~\ref{ex:differentiation-operator-domain-and-unboundedness} 中定义的微分算子 $(\mathcal{D}(D),D)$. 在上述评论中, 提到该算子的定义域并不 ``最优'', 因为它未包括分片可微函数这样显然应考虑的函数. 现在可以看出, 问题在于该算子不是闭的. 按照上面 Lemma~\ref{lem:closable-operator-zero-sequence-criterion} 的证明中的方法构造闭包. 即将闭包的定义域 $\mathcal{D}(\overline D)$ 定义为满足以下条件的函数 $u\in L^2(0,L)$: 存在序列 $u_n\in\mathcal{D}(D)$ 及元素 $v\in L^2(0,L)$, 使得\begin{enumerate}\item $u_n\to u$ 于 $L^2(0,L)$ 中, 且\item $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}u_n}{\mathrm{d}x}\to v$ 于 $L^2(0,L)$ 中.\end{enumerate}然而, 这正是 Sobolev 空间的定义:\[\mathcal{D}(\overline D):=\{u\in H^1(0,L)\mid u(0)=0\},\]其中的边界条件在迹的意义下理解.
